remarks: Tucked away on a quiet street in desirable East Norwalk, this sun-filled two-bedroom end-unit townhouse blends modern updates with unbeatable convenience. Just a five-minute walk to the East Norwalk Metro-North station and Veterans Park, it's ideal for NYC commuters or anyone who loves being close to Long Island Sound's scenic shoreline. Step inside to find a warm and inviting main living/dining area highlighted by gleaming hardwood floors. The beautifully renovated kitchen features a breakfast bar, sleek finishes, and an oversized pantry-perfect for all your culinary essentials. Upstairs, vaulted ceilings enhance the sense of space, while the recently renovated full bath and a laundry closet add everyday practicality. Enjoy the ease of a private one-car garage with extra storage, an assigned parking space, and ample guest parking. Both bathrooms have been tastefully updated, ensuring a move-in-ready experience. This home offers the perfect combination of style, comfort, and location-don't miss your chance to make it yours! Apply today!
